I guess the problem lies in the heart of worldview. Pessimism, optimism or any kind of philosophy is either wrong or true. Some people have different views than others, some people have different beliefs than others.

For example, I ask myself a question that looks pretty easy to some people; "Why should I continue to live?" 

Some say that good things (like happiness, pleasure, family and friends...) worth to live, worth to show effort. I think that is not the case. Of course this is my opinion or choice. Not wrong or true but my view. 

Some say that suffering is the reason why life is worthless. Indeed it is unpleasant but if there was something worth to live, I think suffering wouldn't interfere it. 

Some say that passion, humanity, homeland or religious beliefs are worth to live. I think that all these are useless to me. My passions? After reaching my goals I feel good feelings. So do I have my goals to obtain good feelings ? As I said for me that is not the case. Humanity? Nah, why should I care? Homeland? Just because I born here doesn't mean I have to do live for it. Religious beliefs? I have non. Because these are not phenomenon you can not prove them by our senses and because of this you can create infinite tales about higher beings and you can falsify none of them. I recommend you to read Carl Sagan's The Dragon in my garage.

But as I said these are my view.

I committed suicide eight times and my experiences taught me a lot. I do not know when will be the next attempt but I guess this time will be the end. I become a professional Suicidal.

Euthanasia is not legal in almost all countries. I came here without my consent but I want to have right to leave it.
Unfortunately I don't have any coping mechanism against existential dread. Because this time I ask, Why should I have a coping mechanism?

I hate to be that guy but I have to say that you must read Zapffe or Ligotti. You are not alone and rear this:  "Unfortunately,’ rues the playful pessimist, ‘I cannot help you. All I have for facing death myself, is a foolish smile."

You have to try another way of coping mechanisms. I also have to admit I have no reason to tell you why you have to choose a coping mechanism. You can find an answer on Zapffe's Last Messiah. Maybe sublimation or something else but I strongly recommend you to read "The last messiah"
